mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program ( source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, categories, regions, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url, source_sort_timestamp, startup_details, is_source_present ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{title}, #{organization}, #{summary}, #{categoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{regionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetDescription}, #{applicationPeriodRaw}, #{applicationStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{applicationEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceSortTimestamp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startupDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRUE ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId}, title = #{title}, organization = #{organization}, summary = #{summary}, categories = #{categoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, regions = #{regionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, target_description = #{targetDescription}, application_period_raw = #{applicationPeriodRaw}, application_start_date = #{applicationStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, application_end_date = #{applicationEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, source_sort_timestamp = #{sourceSortTimestamp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, startup_details = #{startupDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_source_present = TRUE, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO support_program ( source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, categories, regions, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url, source_sort_timestamp, startup_details, is_source_present ) VALUES
( #{row.sourceCode}, #{row.sourceProgramId}, #{row.title}, #{row.organization}, #{row.summary}, #{row.categoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.regionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.targetDescription}, #{row.applicationPeriodRaw}, #{row.applicationStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.applicationEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.sourceUrl}, #{row.sourceSortTimestamp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.startupDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRUE )
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_program_id = incoming.source_program_id, title = incoming.title, organization = incoming.organization, summary = incoming.summary, categories = incoming.categories, regions = incoming.regions, target_description = incoming.target_description, application_period_raw = incoming.application_period_raw, application_start_date = incoming.application_start_date, application_end_date = incoming.application_end_date, source_url = incoming.source_url, source_sort_timestamp = incoming.source_sort_timestamp, startup_details = incoming.startup_details, is_source_present = TRUE, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE support_program SET is_source_present = FALSE WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND is_source_present = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, categories, regions, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url, source_sort_timestamp, startup_details FROM support_program WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId} AND is_source_present = TRUE

SELECT source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, categories, regions, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url, source_sort_timestamp, startup_details FROM support_program WHERE is_source_present = TRUE ORDER BY source_code ASC, source_program_id ASC

SELECT program.source_code, program.source_program_id, program.title, program.organization, program.summary, program.categories, program.regions, program.target_description, program.application_period_raw, program.application_start_date, program.application_end_date, program.source_url, program.source_sort_timestamp, program.startup_details FROM support_program program INNER JOIN support_program_sync_status sync_status ON sync_status.source_code = program.source_code WHERE program.is_source_present = TRUE AND sync_status.published_generation IS NOT NULL AND sync_status.published_catalog_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
AND sync_status.index_ready = TRUE
ORDER BY program.source_code ASC, program.source_program_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program_source_document ( source_code, source_program_id, source_url, content, content_hash, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{fetchedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_url = #{sourceUrl}, content = #{content}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, fetched_at = #{fetchedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT document.source_code, document.source_program_id, document.source_url, document.content, document.content_hash, document.fetched_at FROM support_program_source_document document INNER JOIN support_program program ON program.source_code = document.source_code AND program.source_program_id = document.source_program_id WHERE document.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND document.source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId} AND program.is_source_present = TRUE
SELECT latest_started_generation FROM support_program_sync_generation WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} FOR UPDATE

SELECT source_code, published_generation, published_catalog_fingerprint, published_program_count, index_ready, last_successful_sync_at, last_failed_sync_at, last_sync_outcome FROM support_program_sync_status WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode}

SELECT source_code, published_generation, published_catalog_fingerprint, published_program_count, index_ready, last_successful_sync_at, last_failed_sync_at, last_sync_outcome FROM support_program_sync_status UNION ALL SELECT program.source_code AS source_code, NULL AS published_generation, NULL AS published_catalog_fingerprint, COUNT(*) AS published_program_count, FALSE AS index_ready, NULL AS last_successful_sync_at, NULL AS last_failed_sync_at, 'NONE' AS last_sync_outcome FROM support_program program WHERE program.is_source_present = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM support_program_sync_status sync_status WHERE sync_status.source_code = program.source_code ) GROUP BY program.source_code ORDER BY source_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program_sync_status ( source_code, published_generation, published_catalog_fingerprint, published_program_count, index_ready, last_successful_sync_at, last_sync_outcome ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, #{generation}, #{catalogFingerprint}, #{programCount}, TRUE, #{occurredAt}, 'SUCCESS' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE published_generation = #{generation}, published_catalog_fingerprint = #{catalogFingerprint}, published_program_count = #{programCount}, index_ready = TRUE, last_successful_sync_at = #{occurredAt}, last_sync_outcome = 'SUCCESS'

INSERT INTO support_program_sync_status ( source_code, index_ready, last_failed_sync_at, last_sync_outcome ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, FALSE, #{occurredAt}, 'FAILURE' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_failed_sync_at = #{occurredAt}, last_sync_outcome = 'FAILURE'
mapper.update: UPDATE support_program_sync_status SET published_generation = 0, published_catalog_fingerprint = #{catalogFingerprint}, published_program_count = #{programCount}, index_ready = TRUE WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND published_catalog_fingerprint IS NULL
